exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Joining the Green Club
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Hi, Mark, I heard you joined the school Green Club. What do you do there?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: We do lots of things, Lucy. Last week we sorted rubbish for recycling.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: That sounds useful. Is it hard work?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Not really. We just put paper, glass and metal into different bins.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Nice. What are you doing next?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: This Saturday we'll plant young trees on the hill behind the school.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Can I come too? I'd love to help the environment.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Of course! The more hands we have, the more trees we can plant.

exercises.translation_cn: Lucy 听说 Mark 加入了学校环保社,问他们做些什么;Mark 说上周他们把垃圾分类回收,把纸、玻璃、金属放进不同的桶;这周六要在学校后面的山上种小树;Lucy 也想去帮忙保护环境;Mark 欢迎她。

questions.stem: What club did Mark join?
What did the club do last week?
How does the club sort the rubbish?
options: They put paper, glass and metal into different bins.
They throw it into the river.

questions.stem: What will the club do this Saturday?
options: Plant young trees on the hill.

questions.stem: Why does Lucy want to join them?
options: She would love to help the environment.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Why the Earth Is Warming
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Our planet is slowly getting warmer, and this change worries many scientists.
The main cause is the burning of fossil fuels such as coal and oil.
Burning them releases carbon dioxide, a gas that traps heat around the earth.
As the air warms up, the ice at the poles begins to melt and the sea rises.
To slow this trend, we should use clean energy and cut our carbon emissions.
exercises.translation_cn: 地球正在缓慢变暖,这让许多科学家担忧;主要原因是燃烧煤、石油等化石燃料;燃烧会排放二氧化碳,这种气体锁住地球周围的热量;空气变暖后,两极冰开始融化,海平面上升;要减缓这一趋势,我们应使用清洁能源并减少碳排放。

questions.stem: What is happening to our planet?
options: It is staying exactly the same.

questions.stem: What is the main cause of this change?
options: Burning fossil fuels like coal and oil.

questions.stem: What does carbon dioxide do around the earth?
What happens as the air warms up?
options: Polar ice melts and the sea rises.

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest we do?
options: Use clean energy and cut carbon emissions.

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 How Do You Get to School?
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Anna, how do you usually get to school in the morning?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: I ride my bike, Sam. It gives off no carbon dioxide at all.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: That's great. My dad still drives me every day.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Why not walk? Your home isn't very far from here.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: You're right. A car for such a short trip wastes a lot of fuel.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Exactly. Walking or cycling keeps the air cleaner and keeps you fit.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: I'll talk to my dad tonight. Maybe I'll start walking next week.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Good idea! Small changes like that really add up.

exercises.translation_cn: Sam 问 Anna 平时怎么上学;Anna 说骑自行车,完全不排放二氧化碳;Sam 的爸爸每天开车送他;Anna 建议他走路,因为家离学校不远;Sam 承认短途开车很浪费燃料;Anna 说走路或骑车既净化空气又锻炼身体;Sam 打算下周开始走路;Anna 说这种小改变积少成多。

questions.stem: How does Anna usually get to school?
Why is Anna's way good for the environment?
options: It gives off no carbon dioxide.
It needs a lot of fuel.

questions.stem: What does Anna suggest Sam do?
Why is driving for a short trip a problem?
options: It wastes a lot of fuel.

questions.stem: What does Sam decide to do?
options: Talk to his dad and maybe start walking.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 The Forest That People Made
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Long ago, Saihanba in northern China was bare and dry land near a desert.
Sand often blew towards the cities, and the soil could not hold water.
From 1962, young workers were sent there to grow a forest from nothing.
Many early trees died, but the workers learned and never gave up.
After about sixty years, their effort turned the bare hills into a huge green forest.
exercises.translation_cn: 很久以前,中国北方的塞罕坝是靠近沙漠的一片光秃干旱之地;沙子常常吹向城市,土壤无法保水;从1962年起,年轻的工人被派去那里白手起家种林;早期许多树死了,但工人们不断学习、从不放弃;约六十年后,他们的努力把光秃的山岭变成了一片巨大的绿色森林。

questions.stem: What was Saihanba like long ago?
options: Bare and dry land near a desert.

questions.stem: What problem did the sand cause?
options: It made the forest grow faster.
It filled the rivers with fish.

questions.stem: Why were the young workers sent there in 1962?
options: To grow a forest from nothing.

questions.stem: What did the workers do when early trees died?
options: They learned and never gave up.
They left the place at once.

questions.stem: What was the result of their effort?
options: The land turned into a desert.
The bare hills became a huge green forest.
The trees all died in the end.

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Talking about Smog in Class
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: Mr Lee, why does our city sometimes have such heavy smog?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Good question, Tina. Smog forms when smoke from coal mixes with fog.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: So the smoke comes mostly from factories and cars?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Yes, and from homes that still burn coal in winter.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: What can the city do to make the air cleaner?

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: It can restrict cars on busy days and move polluting factories away.

transcript.speaker: A
transcript.text: And we can use cleaner energy, like solar and wind power.

transcript.speaker: B
transcript.text: Exactly. If everyone helps, the smog will slowly disappear.

exercises.translation_cn: Tina 问李老师为什么城市有时雾霾很重;李老师说雾霾是煤烟与雾混合形成的;烟主要来自工厂和汽车,还有冬天烧煤的家庭;要让空气更清洁,城市可在繁忙日子限行、迁走污染工厂;Tina 补充可以使用太阳能和风能等更清洁的能源;李老师说只要人人出力,雾霾会慢慢消失。

questions.stem: What is Tina asking Mr Lee about?
options: How to win a football match.
Why the city sometimes has heavy smog.

questions.stem: How does smog form, according to Mr Lee?
options: When coal smoke mixes with fog.

questions.stem: Where does the smoke mostly come from?
options: From factories, cars and coal-burning homes.

questions.stem: What can the city do to clean the air?
options: Restrict cars and move polluting factories.
Add more cars to the roads.

questions.stem: What clean energy does Tina mention?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Simple Ways to Save Energy
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Saving energy at home is easier than many people think.
When you leave a room, remember to turn off the light.
On a cold day, put on a warm sweater before you turn up the heat.
Do not leave the TV or computer on standby, and unplug them at night.
These small habits save money and help to protect our planet.
exercises.translation_cn: 在家节能比许多人想的要容易;离开房间时记得关灯;天冷时先穿暖毛衣再开暖气;不要让电视或电脑处于待机,晚上把它们拔掉电源;这些小习惯既省钱又有助于保护我们的星球。
